title: Test fails on login page submit button
body:
## Environment
Chrome v120

## Test Failure
The test 'should login with valid credentials' fails when clicking the submit button.

```
  1) LoginForm > should login with valid credentials
      Expected: element to be visible
      Received: element not found
```

## Stack Trace
```
Error: locator.click: Timeout 30000ms exceeded
```
